steps.observation: Work on this for 10 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
Here are three high-impact ways cities can cut their carbon emissions:

1. Upgrade and prioritize sustainable mobility
   • Expand fast, reliable public transit powered by electricity or clean fuels.  
   • Build safe, connected networks for walking and cycling and limit downtown car access.  
   • Adopt congestion pricing, low-emission zones, and incentives for shared or electric vehicles.

2. Make buildings ultra-efficient and low-carbon
   • Enforce stringent energy-efficiency codes for new construction (net-zero or passive-house standards).  
   • Retrofit existing homes, offices, and schools with insulation, high-performance windows, heat pumps, and smart controls.  
   • Encourage district heating/cooling systems that use renewable or waste heat sources.

3. Decarbonize the urban energy supply
   • Deploy rooftop and community solar, urban wind, and battery storage to green the local grid.  
   • Electrify municipal fleets and public buses; install widespread EV charging infrastructure.  
   • Purchase or produce 100 % renewable electricity for city operations and incentivize residents and businesses to do the same.
